product.title: Private Tour: Amsterdam City Walking Tour and Canal Cruise

description.text: Discover the delights of Amsterdam on a private, customizable half-day walking tour of historical and cultural highlights. A personal guide leads past Dam Square, Leiden Square, the Rijksmuseum, and Anne Frank House, with time in Albert Cuyp Market. The outing finishes with a scenic canal cruise so the same private format covers both streets and UNESCO canals. Commentary and pacing stay flexible for visitors who want a private city introduction rather than a fixed group circuit. Stops include Albert Cuyp Market, Rijksmuseum, Dam Square, Leiden Square (Leidseplein).
